policy.question: Which errors stop a script from running?
excluded: module not found / not installed (import-error, unresolved-import, no-name-in-module, missing stubs ...)
unused imports and other style/lint warnings
policy.confidence: high = >= 2 tools agree, or CPython compile() failure; medium = one tool only

false_positive_filters.click_typer_wrapped_calls: calls to click/typer decorated entry points are not linted
false_positive_filters.single_tool_call_errors: a call-signature error seen by only one tool is demoted to runtime_risk
